intro: A comprehensive enterprise HR workspace uniting all 17 modules into one seamless platform.
speakerNotes: Welcome. Today I will present Builtraa HR Management, a unified platform covering all 17 HR operations from daily attendance to payroll and compliance.

intro: 17 sections, grouped by what they help you do.
speakerNotes: These 17 sections cover the full journey of an employee, from joining to leaving.

intro: Governing planned salary revisions alongside structured employee claim corrections.

bullets.desc: Maintains clear metrics of approved adjustments vs. rejected claims.

moduleRight.whyItHelps: Provides a fair, recorded mechanism to resolve salary concerns.

speakerNotes: These two modules govern salary adjustments. Salary Increment handles planned pay revisions, while Salary Discrepancy offers a formal channel for employees to resolve pay issues.
